_README: Copy to the app's userData folder as firebase.config.json, or point PCMS_FIREBASE_CONFIG at this file in dev. These are the PUBLIC Firebase web-app values (Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app, the firebaseConfig object) — they are NOT secrets. googleClientId is the OAuth 2.0 Web client ID used for desktop Google sign-in. Do NOT put GA4 / SendGrid / AI API keys here; those live in the Functions environment.
